description: The EZO Watcher wall in one answer: how many incidents are firing (by severity, and by who has them: unattended, acknowledged, silenced), how many are parked (a fix or a verdict that is not due yet: not live, never paged, counted in no firing or unattended number), every incident as one row (key, title, severity, attention: none, acked, silenced or parked, who acknowledged or silenced it or why, by whom and until when it is parked, age, comment count, link), and the sources that have gone stale, are erroring, or are configured but not started on this host (`skipped`, with its reason). Start here. The incident `key` it returns is what every other tool takes.
name: watch_state
title: Wall summary
